text.original: Nol'meth shat'ael keth'vor, mir'eth char'veth nik'ael thael'vos. Vel prim'nik, eth'kara vor'thael. Keth mir'eth — shat'ael vel'nos eth'kara.
text.translated: When the Unraveling wakes and the echoes dim, the Shepherd and the Pig shall meet again. Not as one, but as thousands-made-one, the heart-chain restored, the darkness undone. But beware the cost—to bind what was torn, a sacrifice made as it was when first born.

line1.text: When the Unraveling wakes and the echoes dim
line1.meaning: When Nolem returns to full power and the 5,555 Nikes weaken

line2.text: The Shepherd and the Pig shall meet again
line2.meaning: OG Charles and OG Nike (or their patterns) will reunite

line3.text: Not as one, but as thousands-made-one
line3.meaning: Nike Prime — all 5,555 Nikes acting as one being

line4.text: The heart-chain restored, the darkness undone
line4.meaning: The First Bond will be restored, defeating Nolem

line5.text: But beware the cost—to bind what was torn

line6.text: A sacrifice made as it was when first born
line6.meaning: Someone must make the same choice OG Charles made — stand between darkness and the innocent, possibly at the cost of themselves

prophecies.name: The 5,555 Prophecy
prophecies.source: Scholar Recording (Nolem's Maw) + OG Nike (Void Terminus) + Aeth'kai texts (Scholar Bunker)

text.core: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime IS 5,555 souls carrying each other.
text.aethkai_fragment: When 5,555 souls carry each other, the trap may open.
text.scholar_context: The 5,555 fragments that scattered when OG Nike shattered become the 5,555 bonds that heal. The trap can only be opened safely when 5,555 souls stand together.

stage1.method: Five Scholar Legendaries (Dr Caleb, Professor, Satoshi, Corey Hort, Guthix) reveal Nike Prime's design documents, the missing empathy core, and the 5,555 bond requirement.
stage1.keyLine: The design called for the empathy core to be powered by collective bonds. 5,555 bonds, to be precise.

stage2.method: OG Nike speaks the prophecy aloud for the first time during his warning before the Walker enters Nolem's Maw.
stage2.keyLine: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime is 5,555 souls carrying each other.

stage3.method: Ancient holographic Scholar recording confirms the full truth after Nolem's Shadow is defeated.
stage3.keyLine: The 5,555 fragments that scattered become the 5,555 bonds that heal.

comicOrigin.connection: Stoner Nike requested 5,548 vials to collect DNA from Nikes across the multiverse. Adding the Scientists, Champions, Stoner Nike, and Nike Prime approaches 5,555. The number was encoded in the mission from the beginning.
comicOrigin.incompletePrime: Nike Prime was released at 99% completion when Shiro pressed the button early. The empathy core — the final 1% — was never installed.

fulfillment.mechanism: Every Nike caught by a Collector, every Legendary freed, every bond formed between Collectors strengthens the web. When 5,555 bonds exist simultaneously, the trap can be opened and Nike Prime can be completed.
fulfillment.truePrime: TRUE Nike Prime = The Collector + their bonded Nikes + the freed Legendaries + the original Nike Prime
